breakdown.description: The prompt declares the layer rigid in shear, which conflicts with the request to compute a nonzero shear strain and relative lateral displacement.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly removes the rigid-in-shear / no-slip constraint. It states 'Treat the adhesive as a deformable, isotropic, linear-elastic solid' and adds 'Do not apply any rigid-body or no-slip constraint; the layer deforms elastically and Δ is finite and non-zero.' This directly corrects the contradiction present in the incomplete prompt and aligns with the ground truth, which simply omits the rigid-shear assumption and proceeds with elastic deformation calculations.
